notes: Instagram Reels now opens inside the APK in a dedicated isolated WebView, replacing the browser Custom Tab. Instagram controls login and navigation. WebView has a weaker privacy boundary: the app technically could access its page; our implementation does not collect credentials or browsing activity. No diary bridge, cookie copying or page injection. Separate process/storage, HTTPS navigation allowlist and screenshot protection. Launch only while unlocked and outside Friend mode; leaving/backgrounding closes the screen. Camera, mic, files and downloads are disabled. No physical-device Instagram login/Reels test. Install over the existing app, do not uninstall.
